scientific_integrity: This is an analytic result with a directly reproducible finite checker; no independent mathematical certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The first-passage survival function and \(N\ge2\) finite-mean cutoff are previously derived in arXiv:2504.13501v4 (S96–S98). Proposed novelty is only the repeated-cycle stationary position law, the uniform-front/mesoscopic-bulk contrast, and the non-self-averaging random exponential empirical profile. Exponential independent speeds, a fixed target and stationary-before-N-infinity limits are required. Independent publication-priority review is outstanding.
title: A uniform front and a random exponential bulk in collective ballistic threshold resetting
